summary: poker_ai --multi_process training is the DEFAULT and is unusable on macOS: the spawned worker re-imports poker_ai, hits the module-level mp.Manager() at agent.py:8 during its own bootstrap, and dies with RuntimeError _check_not_importing_main. A guarded launcher script does NOT fix it (verified); mp.Manager() has to move out of module scope. Consequence: training currently runs single-core only. 50 iterations 3-handed took 27s, 6-handed 376s.
